'''Norbert A'Campo''' (born 27 April 1941)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Base de données des élites suisses {{!}} A'Campo, Norbert |url=https://www2.unil.ch/elitessuisses/personne.php?id=79090 |access-date=2025-02-12 |website=www2.unil.ch}}</ref> is a [[Swiss people|Swiss]] mathematician working on [[singularity theory]]. He earned a doctorate in 1972 from the [[University of Paris-Sud]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=62475}}</ref> In 1974 he was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]],<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |date=2017-11-24 }}, [[International Mathematical Union]], retrieved 2012-11-03.</ref> and in 1988 he was elected president of the [[Swiss Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Societies/Swiss_presidents.html Presidents of the Swiss Mathematical Society], [[MacTutor History of Mathematics archive]], retrieved 2012-11-03.</ref> In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2012-11-03.</ref>
